title: Attune cascade combined 310-clip inspection

scope.label_status: weak source labels / acted labels; not reviewed gold

cascade.name: attune-cascade:sensevoice+emotion2vec+aed+vocalsound-probe+fsd50k-probe
cascade.affect: emotion2vec+ acoustic SER; transcript lexicon excluded
cascade.events_styles: SenseVoice AED UNION validation-selected abstaining frozen VocalSound linear probe UNION validation-selected abstaining frozen FSD50K linear probe
cascade.merge_rule: Deterministic set union by channel and label in AED, VocalSound, FSD50K order. An abstaining probe contributes nothing, preserving AED-only output; if every source is empty, events and styles remain empty. Later duplicates are suppressed. Scream remains a discrete event, not shouting. Sob remains an event, not crying_speech.
cascade.timestamps: whole utterance only; no word or frame localization
cascade.probe_confidence: closed-set softmax diagnostic plus validation selection among max-softmax, energy, and a genuine-negative none logit; not reviewed gold

cascade.span_policy: whole-utterance weak labels and predictions; no localization score

abstention.selection_metric: validation micro-F1 over one expected ID label per in-domain clip and an empty expected set per OOD clip; ties prefer ID macro-F1, lower OOD false-positive rate, then higher ID coverage

limitations: Abstention is selected on bounded cross-domain validation negatives; broader OOD behavior remains unestablished.
All event/style spans are whole-utterance provisional spans.
Weak source labels are not reviewed Attune gold.
FSD50K standalone events do not establish speech-embedded style coverage.
CREMA-D DIS maps to Attune other, never distress.
